eversource.name: Eversource
eversource.lifeSupportNote: Eversource's medical form protects against shutoff for non-payment. It is not an outage-priority program. Ask Eversource what outage notification they offer.

unitil.name: Unitil
unitil.lifeSupportNote: Unitil's Life Support program needs a Medical Alert Form. Unitil will attempt to notify you of planned outages and severe weather; it does not promise uninterrupted service.

liberty.name: Liberty
liberty.lifeSupportNote: Call Liberty to register life-sustaining equipment.

nhec.name: NH Electric Co-op
nhec.lifeSupportNote: Enrollment path not yet confirmed. Call NHEC member services and ask about their medical or life-support list.

other.name: Other / municipal
other.lifeSupportNote: Call the number on the electric bill and ask whether they keep a medical or life-support list.
